description: Source code for the QuicheDataWriter class, implementing methods for writing various data types and variable-length integers, with focus on network byte order encoding and buffer management.

classes.name: QuicheDataWriter
classes.description: A class for serializing data into a buffer with support for various integer sizes, string pieces, padding, and variable-length encoding, optimized for network transmission.

methods.name: WriteUInt8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer to the buffer, converting to network byte order if necessary.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer to the buffer, converting to network byte order if necessary.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer to the buffer, converting to network byte order if necessary.

methods.name: WriteBytesToUInt64
methods.description: Writes a specified number of bytes from a 64-bit integer, handling endianness.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece16
methods.description: Writes a string with a 16-bit length prefix.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece
methods.description: Writes a string directly to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteVarInt62
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit integer as a 62-bit variable-length integer.

methods.name: WriteStringPieceVarInt62
methods.description: Writes a string prefixed with its variable-length encoded size.

methods.name: GetVarInt62Len
methods.description: Determines the length of a 62-bit variable-length integer encoding.

methods.name: WriteVarInt62WithForcedLength
methods.description: Encodes a 62-bit integer with a specified fixed length.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified length.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the buffer's capacity and current length.
